entries.en: “{title}” still has work in progress. Archiving stops it first; you can restore the session later from the “All conversations (show archived)” filter in the sidebar, and the stopped work will not resume on its own.
entries.zh: “{title}”仍有正在进行的工作。归档会先停止这些工作；之后可在侧栏筛选“全部对话（显示已归档）”中恢复会话，被停止的工作不会自动继续。

entries.en: Add details to help us improve. Your submission will include the current conversation log.
entries.zh: 填写详情以帮助我们改进体验，提交内容会包括当前对话的日志

entries.en: Allow agents to choose models for Subagents
entries.zh: 允许 Agent 为子智能体选择模型

entries.en: Archived sessions cannot be opened. Unarchive it to view.
entries.zh: 已归档对话暂时无法查看，请取消归档后查看

entries.en: Browser combinations: Mod+/, Mod+Shift+,, Mod+Shift+.. Mod is Command on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.
entries.zh: 浏览器可用组合：Mod+/、Mod+Shift+,、Mod+Shift+.。Mod 在 Mac 上为 Command，其他系统为 Ctrl。

entries.en: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
entries.zh: 检查更新失败，请检查网络连接后重试。

entries.en: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
entries.zh: 检查更新失败，请稍后重试。

entries.en: Could not download the update. Check your connection and try again.
entries.zh: 下载更新失败，请检查网络连接后重试。

Could not fill the draft. Please try again shortly.
entries.zh: 暂时无法填入草稿，请稍后重试

Could not install the update. Check your connection and try again.
entries.zh: 安装更新失败，请检查网络连接后重试。

entries.en: Could not install the update. Please try again later.
entries.zh: 安装更新失败，请稍后重试。

entries.en: Could not protect desktop key recording. Exit recording and try again.
entries.zh: 无法启用桌面录键保护，请关闭后重试。

entries.en: Could not read {location}. Check access permissions, then {reload}.
entries.zh: 无法读取 {location}。请检查访问权限后{reload}。

entries.en: Could not restore defaults. Your shortcuts are unchanged. Please retry.
entries.zh: 恢复默认失败。原快捷键已保留，请重试。

entries.zh: 未能安全停止任务，更新尚未安装，请稍后重试。

entries.en: Could not save. Please try again.
Could not save. Your previous shortcuts and current draft are preserved. Please retry.
entries.zh: 保存失败。原快捷键和当前草稿已保留，请重试。

entries.en: Could not start the Session export.
entries.zh: 无法启动 Session 导出。

entries.en: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
entries.zh: 拖动调整大小；双击恢复默认值。

entries.en: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
entries.zh: 请输入不小于 0 的整数。

entries.zh: 请输入不小于 1 的整数。

entries.en: Help improve DeepSeek models and products.
entries.zh: 帮助改进 DeepSeek 模型与产品

entries.en: Hold at most two non-modifier keys. Release the keys to try again.
entries.zh: 最多同时按下两个非修饰键。请松开后重试。

entries.en: How long one command may run before it is terminated.
entries.zh: 单条命令允许运行多久，超时即终止。

entries.en: I have reviewed the latest configuration
If a tool defines its own maximum recursion depth, that setting takes precedence.
entries.zh: 如果某个工具单独设置了最大递归深度，以该工具的设置为准。

entries.en: Include Command, Ctrl, or Alt in the combination.
entries.zh: 请同时按下 Command、Ctrl 或 Alt 修饰键。

entries.en: Limit how long each command may run and how much it may output.
entries.zh: 限制每条命令最多能跑多久、最多输出多少内容。

entries.en: Limits how many levels of Subagents an Agent can create.
entries.zh: 限制 Agent 创建子智能体的递归层级。
缺失 {count} 种字体，点击查看

entries.en: New tasks have started. Confirm again to stop the tasks and update.
entries.zh: 有新任务开始运行，请重新确认是否停止任务并更新。

entries.en: No model provider currently advertises a model.
entries.zh: 当前没有模型提供方公布模型。

entries.en: No system prompt in this request
entries.zh: 本次请求没有系统提示词

entries.en: Office conversion did not produce a usable PDF. Check the file and try again.
entries.zh: Office 转换失败，未生成可用的 PDF。请检查该文件后重试。

entries.en: Office conversion timed out. Try again.
Office preview is busy. Try again shortly.
entries.zh: Office 预览任务较多，请稍后重试。

entries.en: Office previews are unavailable. Enable the document preview service on the computer running DeepSeek Harness.
entries.zh: Office 预览不可用。请在运行 DeepSeek Harness 的主机上启用文档预览服务。

entries.en: Only the main Agent can create Subagents
entries.zh: 仅允许主 Agent 创建子智能体
打开第 {index} 个块的工具调用概述

entries.en: Open the original session to complete migration before creating a branch.
entries.zh: 请先打开原会话完成迁移，再创建分支

entries.en: Output beyond this spills to a temporary file rather than being lost.
entries.zh: 超出部分会转存到临时文件，而不是被丢弃。

entries.en: Preparing a ZIP containing this Session, its sub-Sessions, and attachments.
entries.zh: 正在准备包含当前 Session、子 Session 和附件的 ZIP 文件。
连接中断，正在重试，点击立即重连

entries.en: Release the keys to save. Tab moves between actions; Esc cancels.
entries.zh: 松开组合键即保存。Tab 切换操作，Esc 退出录键。

entries.en: Reload to load the new version
Restore the default shortcuts for this platform. All modified or removed shortcuts will be restored. Other platforms are unaffected.
entries.zh: 将恢复当前平台的默认快捷键。你修改或移除的快捷键都会恢复，其他平台不受影响。

entries.en: Select at least one model before saving.
entries.zh: 保存前请至少选择一个模型。
正在选择或添加工作区

entries.en: Session stopped and archived. You can
Set Subagent recursion depth, count, and models.
entries.zh: 设置子智能体的递归层级、数量和模型。

entries.en: Settings changed elsewhere. Discard your draft and try again.
entries.zh: 设置已在其他位置更新。请放弃修改后重试。

entries.en: Shortcut configuration in {location} is damaged. Back up and repair this configuration, then {reload}.
entries.zh: {location} 的快捷键配置内容损坏。请先备份并修复该配置，然后{reload}。

entries.en: Shortcut configuration in {location} was created by a newer version. Upgrade Harness and try again.
entries.zh: {location} 的快捷键配置由更新版本创建。请升级 Harness 后重试。

entries.en: Shortcut configuration or available commands changed. Review the latest bindings before saving.
entries.zh: 快捷键配置或可用命令已更新。请核对最新键位后再保存。

entries.en: Shortcuts are not ready. Please try again.
entries.zh: 快捷键尚未准备好，请稍后重试。

entries.en: Showing the first {n} results. Narrow your search.
entries.zh: 仅显示前 {n} 条结果，请缩小搜索范围。

entries.en: Shows trajectory, code diffs, and all Agent presets
entries.zh: 开启后，显示轨迹、本轮代码差异，可选择完整的 Agent 预设切换

entries.en: Some model providers could not be loaded; saved choices remain removable.
entries.zh: 部分模型提供方暂时无法加载；已保存的选择仍可移除。
子智能体并行数量上限

entries.en: Subagents use configured defaults or inherit the parent agent's model. Saved model choices are retained.
entries.zh: 关闭后，子智能体使用配置的默认模型或继承父 Agent 的模型；已选模型会保留。
系统提示词和工具已更新

entries.en: Task status is unavailable. Try updating again when the workspace is ready.
entries.zh: 无法确认任务状态，请在工作区就绪后重试更新。

entries.en: The browser is downloading the Session ZIP.
entries.zh: 浏览器正在下载 Session ZIP 文件。

entries.en: The description is too long; shorten it and submit again
entries.zh: 描述太长，请缩短后再提交

entries.en: The file changed while being read. Reopen the preview.
entries.zh: 文件在读取时已更改，请重新打开预览。

entries.en: The last successfully read bindings remain active.
entries.zh: 当前继续使用上次读取成功的键位。

entries.en: The Office file or converted PDF exceeds the preview size limit. Reduce the file size or adjust the preview configuration.
entries.zh: Office 文件或转换后的 PDF 超过预览大小上限，请缩小文件或调整预览配置。

entries.en: The service version changed. This page paused live updates; reload to load the new version.
entries.zh: 服务版本已变化，本页面已暂停热更新，刷新后加载新版本。

entries.en: These fonts are unavailable for this preview. Text and layout may differ from the original document.
entries.zh: 本次预览无法使用以下字体，预览中的文字和排版可能与原文档不同。

entries.en: This browser does not support this combination yet.
entries.zh: 此浏览器暂不支持该组合。

entries.en: This combination is reserved for system or text editing actions.
entries.zh: 此组合由系统或文本编辑操作保留。

entries.en: This feedback changed elsewhere; the latest state is shown
entries.zh: 这条反馈已在别处改动，已显示最新状态

entries.en: This Office file cannot be previewed. It may be damaged, password protected, or have the wrong extension.
entries.zh: 无法预览此 Office 文件。文件可能已损坏、受密码保护，或与扩展名不符。

entries.en: This removes “{name}” from the workspace list. The folder and session logs will be kept. Its sessions will appear under Ungrouped.
entries.zh: 将把“{name}”从工作区列表中移除。文件夹与会话记录会保留，其会话将显示在“未分组”下。

entries.en: This session has no completed turn
entries.zh: 当前会话没有已结束的轮次
当前网站本地存储中的 dsh.keybindings.v1

entries.en: Timeline overview; drag horizontally to focus events
entries.zh: 时间线概览；水平拖动可聚焦事件

entries.en: Total live Subagents under the same main Agent, across all recursion levels. The main Agent is excluded. New start requests are rejected when the limit is reached.
entries.zh: 同一主 Agent 下，所有递归层级同时存活的子智能体总数，主 Agent 不计入。达到上限时，新的启动请求会被拒绝。

entries.en: Unable to create default workspace. Use Choose workspace to select a folder.
entries.zh: 无法创建默认工作区，请通过“选择工作区”选择文件夹
取消置顶失败，请稍后重试

entries.en: Upload Session Log when using the official model API
entries.zh: 在使用官方模型 API 时上传 Session Log

entries.en: Use Command+/, Command+,, Command+Backslash, Control+Backquote, Command+Option+key, or Command+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
entries.zh: 可设置 Command+/、Command+,、Command+反斜杠、Control+反引号、Command+Option+按键或 Command+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。

entries.en: Use Ctrl+/, Ctrl+,, Ctrl+Alt+key, or Ctrl+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
entries.zh: 可设置 Ctrl+/、Ctrl+,、Ctrl+Alt+按键或 Ctrl+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。

entries.en: View and edit available shortcuts and input actions
entries.zh: 查看和编辑当前可用的快捷键和输入操作

entries.en: When enabled, agents can choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for each Subagent from the authorized models below. Applies only to new sessions.
entries.zh: 开启后，Agent 可以从下方授权模型中，为每个子智能体选择提供方、模型和推理强度。仅影响新会话。
